You scan the room for a fridge, and you find a fridge. The fridge contains a carrot, a red hot pepper, a raw red potato and a white onion. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting. You can make out a closed oven. You make out a table. On the table you make out a cookbook. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a counter. The counter is vast. But the thing is empty. Aw, here you were, all excited for there to be things on it! You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a stove. The stove is conventional. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage.
